title: Hoisin Cauliflower Bao
subtitle: with Pickled Radish and Sesame Mayo
description: For mouth-watering meat-free morsels, fill soft, pillowy bao buns with golden hoisin cauliflower, then scatter with refreshing pickles. Yummo!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Cut the cauliflower into small florets. Peel the carrot, then shred using a julienne peeler or coarsely grate with a box grater. Thinly slice the radish, stack the slices, then cut into thin matchsticks. Pick the coriander leaves and finely chop the stems.
Make pickle: Combine 1 tbs white vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and a pinch of salt in a large bowl. Add the carrot and radish and toss to combine. Set aside to pickle.

Cook hoisin cauliflower: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Stir-fry the cauliflower for 3 mins or until golden. Add 1 tbs water and cook, covered, for a further 5 mins or until tender. Add the hoisin sauce, coriander stems, 2 tsp soy sauce and 2 tbs water. Cook, stirring, for 1 min or until the sauce is thickened. Remove from the heat.

Steam bao buns: Half-fill a large saucepan with water and bring to a simmer. Lightly oil a steamer basket (see Kitchen hack) and put over the pan. Steam 8 bao buns, in batches if necessary, for 3 mins or until warmed through.

Serve up: Meanwhile, put the sesame seeds and 2 tbs mayonnaise in a bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Drain the pickled vegetables. Open the bao buns and spread with the sesame mayonnaise. Spoon in the hoisin cauliflower, then top with the pickle and coriander leaves. Enjoy!

Kitchen hack: To stop the buns sticking to the base of the steamer, either oil it or line with baking paper (punch several holes in the paper to let the steam in). If you don't have a steamer basket, heat the buns in a large colander or sieve placed over the pan of simmering water. Cover with a lid.
